credits.title: Bhāvāntara
credits.overview: Rooted in real-world human emotions and sacred traditions, a poignant story unfolds around the transgender experience, blending scripted narrative with unscripted footage from the vibrant Koovagam Festival.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

credits.title: Cold Call
credits.overview: In the winter of 2023, the Media is buzz with the kidnapping case of a 13-year-old boy. The Investigators find that a group of 4 Market Research Executive (MRE) are prime suspects.
